items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: Doris Day, Mantovani, Vera Lynn, you know, the kind of popular music

ctx.x: Well it was in my house too.

Yeah. They had their special musical interests at home. They just liked what they heard on the radio. Doris Day, Mantovani, Vera Lynn, you know, the kind of popular music — the popular music prior to the days of The Beatles and rock & roll if you like.
But they didn’t embrace any of the swing music that came over.
